items.source: Scan the classpath for @JacksonMixin in the specified basePackages.
Create an instance using the specified JacksonMixinModuleEntries.Builder.
items.translation: 使用指定的 JacksonMixinModuleEntries.Builder 创建实例。

items.source: Perform an action on each entry defined by this instance. If a class needs to be resolved from its class name, the specified ClassLoader is used.
items.translation: 对由本实例定义的每个条目执行操作。如果需要从其类名解析类，则使用指定的 ClassLoader。

items.source: classLoader - the classloader to use to resolve class name if necessary
items.translation: classLoader - 用于在必要时解析类名的类加载器

items.source: action - the action to invoke on each type to mixin class entry
an instance with the state of the customized builder.
items.translation: 一个具有自定义构建器状态的实例。

items.source: an instance with the result of the scanning

items.translation: JacksonMixinModuleEntries 的构建器。

items.source: Provides the mapping of Jackson mixin classes to consider.
items.translation: 提供要考虑的 Jackson 混合类（mixin class）的映射。
